T101.status: same explicitly verified Aamk attribute table and local contribution contract as T000; distinct learned ID

difference.DataD: Ihid Hide Button, explicitly1 at levels1-4; source null5-6 retained
difference.selectedUI: hide learned command-card button at all six ranks; preserve learn/upgrade entry and inspection of effective contribution
difference.authority: Q24 local choice extends explicit hidden state to missing levels5-6; not removing ability or treating learning as unavailable
difference.label: https://github.com/actboy168/YDWE/blob/a69c315ebf2886ec54d66200707ab6e38bd3484d/Development/Component/share/en-US/mpq/UI/WorldEditStrings.txt#L6187

webSelections.getter: native HERO only; false returns integer base (natural + explicit base adjustment), true adds active integer attribute contributions including T000/T101/items; nonhero/nil/removed returns0
webSelections.setterTrue: absolute base assignment max(0,trunc(value)); preserve active bonus contributions and natural-growth ledger by changing explicit base adjustment; no skill/level event; all44 business calls use true
webSelections.derivedDelta: Each native HERO effective STR delta changes maxLife by15*delta, INT changes maxMana by12*delta; base template HP + attribute and separately owned contributions, maxLife>=1,maxMana>=0; Primary case-insensitive only STR/AGI/INT
webSelections.currentAfterAttributeDelta: For SetHero*(true), natural level changes and T000 rank changes, add actual corresponding maximum-resource delta to current; alive life clamp[1,newMax], dead life stays0; mana clamp[0,newMax]. Do not batch source subtract/add sequences; no revive/death/damage callbacks generated
webSelections.T000: actual learned rank1..6 adds10*rank to each bonus channel, not cumulative10+20; add/remove/disable/re-enable recomputes once. No standalone random/attack proc or learning script. Native HERO only. Illusion copying follows separately selected creation policy, not universal auto-copy here
webSelections.T101: same independently verified six-rank attribute contribution as T000; preserve distinct learned ID/paid history, hide learned command-card icon while keeping learning entry. No automatic granting T000 or double natural-growth write. Abnormal simultaneous T000+T101 acquisition is not invented by this adapter
webSelections.directMaximumWrite: SetUnitState MAX_LIFE/MAX_MANA changes corresponding direct offset so getter equals clipped requested total, retains offset on later stat changes; preserve absolute current with immediate clamp, do not add attribute-style delta; matches existing essence-aura local max-mana choice
webSelections.currentWrite: preserve fractions and clamp to resource bounds; mana cannot kill; life death/explicit resurrection event ordering is outside this attribute-only interface
webSelections.attackAndRegenContribution: effective primary*1.4 enters native base weapon amount once, effective AGI*.002 feeds attack-timing-v1, armor AGI contribution0; STR*.1 and INT*.03 feed native regen inputs, with unit regenType and other ability multipliers resolved by regen subsystem
webSelections.order: settle previously selected continuous regen to event time, then each native setter is observable in source order; W019 subtraction and addition are six separate calls when old nonzero; never replace with one net delta
webSelections.save: save base adjustment, natural baseline, explicit native contributions/direct max offsets, current resources, W019 old amount per tower slot; do not replay setter or learning callbacks
webSelections.falseSetter: No false call in47 literal source sites; not guessed as temporary attribute ownership. If later dynamic caller found, resolve separately before use

remaining: all skill/item-specific acquisition/reversal predicates around other setters
full Acha/ANeg and illusion attribute transfer
native regeneration eligibility/day/night/blight and percentage providers
general death/resurrection transaction and non-attribute current-life writes
